run.original_rule_yaml:
title: Schtasks Creation Or Modification With SYSTEM Privileges
id: 89ca78fd-b37c-4310-b3d3-81a023f83936
status: test
description: Detects the creation or update of a scheduled task to run with "NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM" privileges
references:
    - https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/exploring-the-qbot-attack-pattern
    - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/schtasks
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
date: 2022-07-28
modified: 2025-02-15
tags:
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.execution
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1053.005
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection_root:
        Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - ' /change '
            - ' /create '
    selection_run:
        CommandLine|contains: '/ru '
    selection_user:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'NT AUT' # This covers the usual NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM
            - ' SYSTEM ' # SYSTEM is a valid value for schtasks hence it gets it's own value with space
    filter_optional_teamviewer:
        # FP from test set in SIGMA
        # Cannot use ParentImage on all OSes for 4688 events
        # ParentImage|contains|all:
        #     - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        #     - 'TeamViewer_.exe'
        Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - '/TN TVInstallRestore'
            - '\TeamViewer_.exe'
    filter_optional_office:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            # https://answers.microsoft.com/en-us/msoffice/forum/all/office-15-subscription-heartbeat-task-created-on/43ab5e53-a9fb-47c6-8c14-44889974b9ff
            - 'Subscription Heartbeat'
            - '\HeartbeatConfig.xml'
            - '\Microsoft Shared\OFFICE'
    filter_optional_avira:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '/Create /F /RU System /SC WEEKLY /TN AviraSystemSpeedupVerify /TR '
            - ':\Program Files (x86)\Avira\System Speedup\setup\avira_speedup_setup.exe'
            - '/VERIFY /VERYSILENT /NOSTART /NODOTNET /NORESTART" /RL HIGHEST'
    condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
falsepositives:
    - Unknown
level: high
run.final_rule_yaml:
title: Schtasks Creation Or Modification With SYSTEM Privileges
id: 89ca78fd-b37c-4310-b3d3-81a023f83936
status: test
description: Detects the creation or update of a scheduled task to run with "NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM" privileges
references:
    - https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/exploring-the-qbot-attack-pattern
    - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/schtasks
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
date: 2022-07-28
modified: 2025-02-15
tags:
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.execution
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1053.005
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection_root:
        Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
        OriginalFileName: 'schtasks.exe'
    selection_action:
        CommandLine|contains|windash:
            - 'create'
            - 'change'
    selection_ru:
        CommandLine|contains|windash: 'ru '
    selection_user:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM'
            - 'NT AUT'
            - 'SYSTEM'
    filter_optional_teamviewer:
        Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - '/TN TVInstallRestore'
            - '\TeamViewer_.exe'
    filter_optional_office:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'Subscription Heartbeat'
            - '\HeartbeatConfig.xml'
            - '\Microsoft Shared\OFFICE'
    filter_optional_avira:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '/Create /F /RU System /SC WEEKLY /TN AviraSystemSpeedupVerify /TR '
            - ':\Program Files (x86)\Avira\System Speedup\setup\avira_speedup_setup.exe'
            - '/VERIFY /VERYSILENT /NOSTART /NODOTNET /NORESTART" /RL HIGHEST'
    condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
falsepositives:
    - Unknown
level: high
run.rationale:
The attack behavior is: an attacker runs schtasks.exe (or a renamed copy) with the /create or /change action, specifies /ru (run-as user), and sets the user to SYSTEM or NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM to run a scheduled task with SYSTEM privileges.

The original rule missed all mutations because:
1. `CommandLine|contains: ' /create '` requires literal spaces around the keyword, so it fails when quotes are inserted (/\"create\"), when dashes are swapped (-create), or when .exe is omitted (schtasks /create).
2. `CommandLine|contains: '/ru '` has the same space issue.
3. `CommandLine|contains: ' SYSTEM '` requires surrounding spaces, missing "SYSTEM" at end of line or with quotes.

Hardening changes:
- Replaced exact-spaced literals with `|contains|windash` on short tokens (`create`, `change`, `ru `) to tolerate dash/underscore/quote variants and argument reordering.
- Added `OriginalFileName: schtasks.exe` to catch renamed copies.
- Expanded `selection_user` to include the full string `NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM`, the abbreviated `NT AUT` (original), and bare `SYSTEM` (no surrounding spaces required) to catch all quoting/placement variants.
- Kept all original filters (TeamViewer, Office, Avira) unchanged to preserve false-positive suppression.

Result: 4/4 attacks detected (100% evasion resistance) with 0 false alarms.

checks.name: no_lost_attacks
checks.detail: 0 attacks the original caught are now missed
